limitations.text: No imagery usable: imagery_window returned not_allowed for GSI and Sentinel-2, and vision_subagent is not configured. Only a synthetic 160 m embedding index (aef-10m-annual, pooled from 10 m, 3430 cells, whole AOI ~87 km2 covered by the index) was available. A linear probe trained on 10 PLATEAU example points (vs random cells) gave scores with no visual or class check, so factories, markets and hangars cannot be separated from warehouses, and building footprint (>=1600 m2) cannot be confirmed. 35 candidate cells >=0.8 (9 with score >=0.866), but they are unverified, so I assert none as present. Count estimate: unverified; indicative range 9-35 candidate sites, true warehouse count likely lower and not determinable. All 87 km2 is unreviewed visually. 160 m cells were chosen as the finest available grid (Clay at 1280 m is too coarse). The probe returned only the top 100 cells, so the candidate list is truncated.

understanding.goal_restated: Find all warehouses (>=~1600 m2) in AOI near Nagoya port (136.82-136.92E, 35.05-35.12N), 2024, as points with evidence, count range.
known_limits: 10 m embeddings cannot separate warehouses from factories well
Limited tool budget limits full verification
understanding.scope: AOI ~9x8 km; embeddings retrieval then visual verification using GSI aerial and Sentinel-2.
